description: CRITICAL BATCH PROCESSING - Extract ALL data from Halliburton DDR.zip using pattern-based classification and batch processing. Archive contains 24 PDFs from 3 distinct sources with consistent patterns. System must: (1) Identify PDF classes by source/pattern, (2) Batch process each class using extract_multiple_pdfs, (3) Generate complete HTML reports with inline SVG charts. NOTHING can be missed - this is mission-critical operational data.

execution_preferences.task_organization: BATCH PROCESSING BY PDF CLASS: Create 3 batch processing tasks, one per PDF class. Each batch task is COMPLETE END-TO-END (extraction + HTML generation). (1) BATCH 1 - Pemex/Old-Petroecuador Class (14 PDFs): Identify all PDFs from Pemex source (Spanish, 'Hrs' column, 1-2 pages, simple hourly format). Use extract_multiple_pdfs to process ALL 14 PDFs in ONE call. Generate individual HTML reports + JSON for each. Output: 14 HTML files, 14 JSON files, 1 batch summary. (2) BATCH 2 - Petrobras LIBRA Class (5 PDFs): Identify all PDFs from Petrobras source ('Daily Drilling Report (LIBRA)', English/Portuguese, 5-6 pages, cost sections). Use extract_multiple_pdfs to process ALL 5 PDFs in ONE call. Generate individual HTML reports + JSON for each. Output: 5 HTML files, 5 JSON files, 1 batch summary. (3) BATCH 3 - Modern Petroecuador Class (5 PDFs): Identify all PDFs from modern Petroecuador source ('DAILY OPERATIONS', 'EP PETROECUADOR', English, 1-3 pages). Use extract_multiple_pdfs to process ALL 5 PDFs in ONE call. Generate individual HTML reports + JSON for each. Create master index.html aggregating ALL 24 reports. Output: 5 HTML files, 5 JSON files, 1 master index.html. CRITICAL: Each batch task handles EVERYTHING for its PDF class - extraction, translation, HTML generation, JSON output. NO separate tasks per PDF.

verification_requirements: CRITICAL BATCH VERIFICATION: Each batch task MUST verify ALL outputs before success. For each PDF in batch: (1) Verify JSON contains real extracted data (not placeholders), (2) Verify HTML report displays complete data with charts, (3) Verify translations accurate, (4) Verify ALL events/costs/operations captured. Batch task fails if ANY PDF incomplete.
additional_instructions: BATCH PROCESSING WORKFLOW: STEP 1 - CLASSIFY PDFs BY SOURCE PATTERN: Unzip halliburton_ddr.zip. Read first page of each PDF to identify source/pattern. Classify into 3 classes: CLASS A (Pemex/old-Petroecuador): Spanish language, contains 'Hrs' or 'Horas' column, 1-2 pages, simple table format, operator name contains 'Pemex' or old Petroecuador format. CLASS B (Petrobras LIBRA): Contains 'Daily Drilling Report (LIBRA)' header, English/Portuguese, 5-6 pages, detailed cost sections, operator 'Petrobras'. CLASS C (Modern Petroecuador): Contains 'DAILY OPERATIONS' and 'EP PETROECUADOR' headers, English, 1-3 pages, structured format, 2023 dates. Output: classification_map.json mapping each PDF to its class. STEP 2 - BATCH EXTRACT BY CLASS: For EACH class, use extract_multiple_pdfs tool with ALL PDFs of that class in ONE call. JSON Schema: {"pdf_filename": "...", "source_class": "A/B/C", "metadata": {"document_date": "...", "rig_name": "...", "well_name": "...", "operator": "...", "report_number": "...", "all_header_fields": {...}}, "costs": {"currency": "...", "daily_cost": "...", "cumulative_cost": "...", "afe_cost": "...", "estimated_cost": "...", "approved_cost": "...", "cost_breakdown": [...]}, "events": [{"type": "...", "description_en": "FULL English translation", "description_original": "...", "start_time": "...", "end_time": "...", "duration_hours": "...", "severity": "...", "impact": "...", "cost_impact": "..."}], "operations": [{"hour": "...", "description_en": "FULL English translation", "description_original": "...", "activity_type": "...", "equipment": "...", "personnel": "..."}], "key_metrics": {"total_depth": "...", "drilling_hours": "...", "npt_hours": "...", "production_rate": "...", "all_metrics": {...}}, "tables": [{"table_name": "...", "headers": [...], "rows": [...]}], "summary": {"english_summary": "DETAILED 3-5 sentence summary", "key_findings": [...], "critical_events": [...], "safety_incidents": [...]}}. Extraction Instructions: 'Extract EVERY data point from this PDF. Translate ALL non-English text to English (preserve originals). Extract ALL costs with currency. Extract EVERY event with complete details. Extract ALL hourly operations. Extract ALL tables. Extract ALL metadata from headers. Do NOT estimate or fabricate - only actual data. Use null for missing fields.' STEP 3 - GENERATE HTML REPORTS (IN SAME BATCH TASK): For EACH PDF in batch, generate professional HTML report: detailed_report_<pdfname>.html with sections: [Executive Summary - 3-5 sentences], [Document Metadata - table with all header fields], [Cost Analysis - cards + inline SVG bar chart showing cost breakdown], [Events Timeline - sortable table + inline SVG timeline visualization], [Hourly Operations - table with translated descriptions + inline SVG activity chart], [Key Metrics Dashboard - metric cards with icons], [Data Tables - all extracted tables with styling], [Visual Analytics - 3-5 inline SVG charts: cost trends, activity distribution, time breakdown, event frequency]. Styling: Modern professional CSS with gradient header (#2c3e50 to #3498db), card-based layout, responsive grid, color-coded sections (costs: green, events: red, operations: blue), hover effects, box shadows, smooth animations. ALL text in English. Self-contained (inline CSS + SVG). STEP 4 - BATCH OUTPUTS: For each batch, create: (1) Individual JSON files: outputs/json/<pdfname>.json, (2) Individual HTML reports: outputs/html/<pdfname>.html, (3) Batch summary: outputs/batch_<class>_summary.json with aggregated stats. STEP 5 - MASTER INDEX (Batch 3 only): Create index.html aggregating ALL 24 reports with: [Executive Dashboard - total PDFs, total events, total costs, date range], [PDF Class Summary - 3 cards showing stats per class], [Events and Cost Analysis Table - sortable with columns: Date, Operator, Rig, Event Type, Description (English), Duration, Cost Impact, View Report Link - sorted by cost descending], [Cost Overview - stacked bar chart by operator, pie chart by class, trend line], [Events Analysis - bar chart by type, severity distribution], [Operations Timeline - Gantt-style chart], [Comparative Analysis - multi-series charts comparing classes]. Professional enterprise styling, interactive, self-contained. CRITICAL RULES: (1) Use extract_multiple_pdfs for batch processing (NOT one-by-one), (2) Each batch task does EVERYTHING (extract + HTML + JSON), (3) Verify ALL outputs before claiming success, (4) Extract ONLY actual data (no estimation), (5) Translate ALL non-English content.
